comment: Rhonda was a visitor at my school, and she was terrible. She seems very successful and educated, yet I learned nothing from her, as almost everything she puts forth is rooted in confirmation bias or basic but masked in pseudo-academic language. The class wasn't hard, just very uninteresting; everything is either reading or group projects. Avoid.

The grade isn't the problem; an A is totally achievable, but I have never hated a class more in my life. Sharpe means well (I think), but comes off very condescending and above-it-all. Extremely unapproachable and makes you feel bad for asking questions. 65% of your grade will be group projects, so it's carry or sink. I taught myself everything.

Very rude and disrespectful. She talks down to students and takes out bad moods on them. Simply goes through topics and does problems so it's hard to actually learn anything. There's a few projects throughout the semester but she's very critical and specific about them. She's interested in students' lives but is mainly very inconsiderate.
